name: Frigate NVR
title: frigate.video
shortDescription: Frigate NVR is an open source network video recorder that leverages real-time AI object detection to monitor security cameras. It processes all data locally, ensuring privacy and eliminating cloud dependencies. Ideal for home automation enthusiasts, Frigate can detect objects like people or cars, enhancing security without false positives. It integrates seamlessly with Home Assistant and other platforms, making it a versatile tool for smart home setups.
pros: Seamless integration with home automation platforms
cons: Potentially complex setup for non-technical users
Limited to local network without cloud support
